Point Grey is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 101 homes sold there: 67 houses, 21 condos, 7 townhomes and 6 duplexes. 67 houses sold in Point Grey with a median price of $3,050,000 (the middle half sold between $2,552,500 and $4,227,619), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 93.8% of the last list price; 4% sold above list.
Point Grey home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

67 houses sold in Point Grey with a median price of $3,050,000 (the middle half sold between $2,552,500 and $4,227,619), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 93.8% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $1,095 per square foot, a median year built of 1984 and a median lot of 4,093 square feet. 21 condos sold in Point Grey with a median price of $875,000 (the middle half sold between $608,000 and $1,050,000), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $891 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $541 a month.

items.t: Lord Byng Secondary, at 3939 West 16th Avenue, is described by VSB as in the West Point Grey neighbourhood.
The Municipality of Point Grey was set up in 1908 by separating from South Vancouver; the City history page gives no modern boundary.
The Jericho Lands lie near Jericho Beach Park and Trimble Park, with NW Marine Drive, Point Grey Road and West 4th Avenue shown on the City's map.
Low-density lots are in the City's R1-1 zone, which consolidated nine RS zones into one, covering about 65,000 lots.
R1-1 permits duplexes and single detached houses outright; multiple dwellings (up to 8 units) are conditional and need rear-lane access and a site outside a designated flood plain.

blocks.text: Point Grey: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: The City parks map shows Jericho, Locarno and Spanish Banks beach parks; Jericho Beach is one of 11 staffed beaches, and Pacific Spirit Regional Park is run by Metro Vancouver.
West Point Grey Community Centre is at 4397 West 2nd Avenue, with a gym, fitness centre, pottery studio and Aberthau Mansion.

blocks.text: Point Grey: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: Multiple-dwelling eligibility under R1-1 excludes designated flood plain sites.
A detention tank requirement applies to new single detached houses, duplexes and multiplexes from July 1, 2025.
Empty Homes Tax: annual declaration; 3% of assessed value for properties deemed or declared empty in the 2025 reference year (page as retrieved Nov 2026).

faq.q: What did homes in Point Grey sell for?
faq.a: 67 houses sold in Point Grey between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $3,050,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Point Grey?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 93.8% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Point Grey sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 67 houses that sold in Point Grey went for between $2,552,500 and $4,227,619, around a median of $3,050,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Point Grey sell above asking price?
faq.a: 4% of the 67 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 93.8% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Point Grey?
faq.a: The median year built was 1984 for the 67 houses sold in Point Grey.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Point Grey usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Point Grey had 5 bedrooms, from the 67 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
